description: Add three read-only diagnostic CLI commands (mo system info, mo opencode models, mo runner status) wiring to existing server GET endpoints, plus rename the service-lifecycle verb to mo runner service-status to resolve the naming collision.

tasks.title: Implement mo system info command with graceful degradation
tasks.description: Add a new top-level `SystemCommands` group (new file `MohistCliCommands.System.cs`) registered in `MohistCliCommands.Build`, exposing `mo system info`. It sends GET /api/system/info (global, no project resolution) and renders the six diagnostic sections (identity/source/install/update/services/paths) via a dedicated `RenderSystemInfo` helper (not a TableShape, per Decision 2). In `-o json` mode print the raw server payload verbatim. Wrap the GET in try/catch for HttpRequestException: on server-down, print a "server not running" notice to stderr, print a locally-derivable subset (CLI version) to stdout, and exit 0 (Decision 3). `--help` text must disambiguate from client-local `mo info`. Add xUnit specs covering table rendering, JSON raw payload, graceful degradation, and help disambiguation.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo system info` sends GET /api/system/info with no project resolution
Table mode renders identity/source/install/update/services/paths sections grouped by header
`mo system info -o json` prints the raw server response payload without omission
When the server is unreachable, the command prints a "server not running" notice plus a locally-derivable subset (e.g. CLI version) and exits 0 (no hard error)
`mo system info --help` explains it reports server-side diagnostics and distinguishes it from `mo info` (CLI local environment)
xUnit specs using RecordingHttpHandler + RunAsync cover: table rendering of all sections, JSON raw payload, graceful degradation on HttpRequestException, and help disambiguation
`npm test` passes (server TreatWarningsAsErrors acts as lint; CLI tests in same suite)
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.System.cs (new), registration in MohistCliCommands.Build, PrintSystemInfoAsync + RenderSystemInfo in MohistCliApi, and xUnit specs in packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests/
tasks.notes: Follow RenderRunnerShow (MohistCliApi.cs:341) as the established pattern for single-object multi-section key/value rendering. Do NOT reuse InfoCollector for the degraded subset (Decision 3 rejects coupling).

tasks.title: Implement mo opencode models command (project-scoped, copy-paste output)
tasks.description: Add a new top-level `OpencodeCommands` group (new file `MohistCliCommands.Opencode.cs`) registered in `MohistCliCommands.Build`, exposing `mo opencode models` with `--project`/`--project-id`/`-o` options (reuse ProjectRefOption() + OutputOption). The action resolves the project via ResolveProjectIdAsync (same pattern as `mo runner list`), then calls a new PrintOpencodeModelsAsync(projectId, mode) hitting GET /api/projects/{projectId}/opencode/models. In table mode print exactly one model ID per line with no header/decoration (directly copy-pasteable into --model). In JSON mode print the full data object ({models, modelVariants}) verbatim, preserving variant info. When no project resolves, print a clear error and exit non-zero. Add xUnit specs covering one-ID-per-line table output, JSON raw payload preservation, and project-resolution failure.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo opencode models` resolves the project via --project/--project-id or active-project fallback, then sends GET /api/projects/{projectId}/opencode/models
Table mode prints exactly one model ID per line with no extra per-row decoration (e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet` and `openai/gpt-5` on separate lines)
`mo opencode models -o json` prints the raw server payload including the `models` array and any model-variant fields (modelVariants preserved)
When no project is resolvable, the command prints a clear error explaining no project is resolved and exits non-zero
xUnit specs using RecordingHttpHandler + RunAsync cover: one-ID-per-line table output, JSON raw payload with modelVariants, and project-resolution failure
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Opencode.cs (new), registration in MohistCliCommands.Build, PrintOpencodeModelsAsync in MohistCliApi, and xUnit specs in packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests/
tasks.notes: Endpoint is project-scoped despite the issue body describing it as global (verified: OpencodeRoutes.cs:16). Do NOT render modelVariants in table mode (out of scope; Decision 4).

tasks.title: Implement mo runner status online diagnostic and rename service-lifecycle verb to service-status
tasks.description: In RunnerCommands.Build (MohistCliCommands.Server.cs), rename the existing service-lifecycle verb from `status` to `service-status` (pure rename: same --dry-run/--unit-dir flags, same StatusRunnerAsync handler) per Decision 6. Add a new `BuildStatus(api)` under the freed `status` name carrying --project/--project-id/-o, which calls a new PrintRunnerStatusAsync(projectId, mode) hitting GET /api/projects/{projectId}/runners and rendering via a new RenderRunnerStatus (added to TableRenderer.Runners.cs) with a focused 3-column view: id | heartbeat | state, where state is `idle` when capacity.usedSlots == 0 else `busy` (reuse FormatHeartbeat from TableRenderer.cs:201). Empty runner list prints "No runners connected" and exits 0. JSON mode prints the raw runner payload. Project-resolution failure prints a clear error and exits non-zero. Add xUnit specs covering the online summary table, JSON raw payload, empty-runner case, project-resolution failure, service-status behavior preservation, and help listing both verbs distinctly.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo runner status` sends GET /api/projects/{projectId}/runners and renders a focused summary: id, last heartbeat, and idle/busy state (idle when used capacity is zero)
`mo runner status -o json` prints the raw server runner payload
Empty runner list prints "No runners connected" and exits 0
When no project is resolvable, `mo runner status` prints a clear error and exits non-zero

`mo runner service-status` invokes the same service-installer status action as the former `mo runner status` verb, accepting the same --dry-run and --unit-dir options (behavior identical, pure rename)
`mo runner --help` lists `status` as the online-runner diagnostic and `service-status` as the service-lifecycle status, with distinct descriptions
The focused status view (3 columns: id/heartbeat/state) is visually distinct from the full-detail `mo runner list` (7 columns)

xUnit specs using RecordingHttpHandler + RunAsync cover: online summary table with idle+busy runners, JSON raw payload, empty-runner case, project-resolution failure, service-status behavior preservation, and help disambiguation between the two verbs
tasks.output: Modified MohistCliCommands.Server.cs (RunnerCommands.Build: rename + add BuildStatus), PrintRunnerStatusAsync in MohistCliApi, RenderRunnerStatus in TableRenderer.Runners.cs, and xUnit specs in packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests/
tasks.notes: Breaking rename is acceptable per AGENTS.md (active development, no version-compat obligation). Derive idle/busy from capacity.usedSlots, NOT the status field (Decision 5). The rename and new diagnostic are coupled in a single task because both modify RunnerCommands.Build atomically.
